subject.title: refactor: prune unsupported OPENCLAW env overrides

question: Should this release immediately stop recognizing the three existing `OPENCLAW_CLAWHUB_*` credential/config aliases, or should their removal include an upgrade warning or deprecation period?
rationale: The aliases are undocumented and duplicate canonical upstream variables, but current runtime behavior accepts them and removal can silently change authentication and routing for existing deployments; repository policy treats that as an explicit compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept immediate removal
options.body: Confirm the aliases are unsupported implementation detail, require canonical-variable live proof, and accept that legacy-only deployments must update during upgrade.

options.title: Add an upgrade warning
options.body: Detect legacy-only variables long enough to emit an actionable warning directing operators to the canonical `CLAWHUB_*` names before removing recognition.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Land the test-only and terminal-setting cleanup now while deferring the credential/config aliases to a dedicated compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Accept immediate removal
recommendation.body: Confirm the aliases are unsupported implementation detail, require canonical-variable live proof, and accept that legacy-only deployments must update during upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the canonical cleanup issue and recorded the intended immediate-removal policy in the PR discussion.
